But to come away with a Silver medal is just a fairytale - and that fairytale happened to Ian Tullett in the pole vault following a slightly hesitant start in a difficult cross wind.

Ian Tullett maintained his steady progress, finishing 3rd in 5.20m. Lennie Paul won the 100 metres with the slight assistance of a 3 metre per second following wind to set a huge pb of 10.25, beating Olympian Darren Braithwaite by 6/100ths.
Ian Tullett, another athlete sidelined by injury, quickly showed that 18 months out had not led to a loss of memory for the pole vault as he had quickly achieved 5.20m to gain selection.
In the pole vault we got well clear of the 'Eastern Electric' men with Ian Tullett surprising a tired Mike Edwards to break Mike's sequence of seven straight league wins.
